messages.content: Write one ordinary pure Python Boolean function implementing section152(c)(1) using the supplied source and scalar input contract. The caller supplies explicit primitive/previously stated inputs; do not introduce a qualifying_child input or return a fixed test answer. Each interval count is a count of calendar days, including endpoints; year length is the actual calendar-year day count. Use all four statutory conditions, including paragraph3. You receive no case facts, queries or labels. Use integer/Boolean arithmetic, assignments, if/else, return and min/max only; no imports, I/O, loops, decorators or chained comparisons. Unknown values are handled by the shared symbolic caller, not by defaulting to true/false/zero in your code. Return only one complete Python function, no JSON or explanation.

{"source_152_c": "(c) Qualifying child

For purposes of this section-

    (1) In general

    The term "qualifying child" means, with respect to any taxpayer for any taxable year, an individual-

        (A) who bears a relationship to the taxpayer described in paragraph (2),

        (B) who has the same principal place of abode as the taxpayer for more than one-half of such taxable year,

        (C) who meets the age requirements of paragraph (3), and

        (E) who has not filed a joint return (other than only for a claim of refund) with the individual's spouse for the taxable year beginning in the calendar year in which the taxable year of the taxpayer begins.

    (2) Relationship

    For purposes of paragraph (1)(A), an individual bears a relationship to the taxpayer described in this paragraph if such individual is-

        (A) a child of the taxpayer or a descendant of such a child, or

        (B) a brother, sister, stepbrother, or stepsister of the taxpayer or a descendant of any such relative.

    (3) Age requirements

    For purposes of paragraph (1)(C), an individual meets the requirements of this paragraph if such individual is younger than the taxpayer claiming such individual as a qualifying child and is less than 25 years old at the end of the taxable year.

", "function_header": "def qualifying_child(relationship_152_c_2: bool, same_abode_days: int, tax_year_days: int, younger_than_taxpayer: bool, age_at_year_end: int, joint_nonrefund_return: bool) -> bool:", "provided_input_contract": {"relationship_152_c_2": "The paragraph2 relationship holds for this taxpayer/individual/year, explicitly supplied or separately proved; this is not the complete qualifying-child conclusion.", "same_abode_days": "Count of same-principal-abode days in this taxable year from the case residence records under the original native-case normalization. Do not substitute a kinship relationship interval.", "tax_year_days": "Number of calendar days in the taxable year.", "younger_than_taxpayer": "Whether the individual is younger than the taxpayer; unknown remains unknown.", "age_at_year_end": "Integer age of the individual at the end of the taxable year; unknown remains unknown.", "joint_nonrefund_return": "Whether the individual filed the joint return excluded by paragraph1(E); marriage alone does not establish this."}}
